global: This is tonkotsu ramen, its rich, creamy broth glowing warmly. Toppings—chashu, nori, menma, and a soft-boiled egg—nestle artfully in the bowl’s blue-and-white pattern, set against a wooden table under soft, inviting light.

regions.background: Light brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and smooth surface beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: Blue and white ceramic bowl with intricate floral pattern, glossy finish, and raised decorative rim.
regions.soup: The broth with noodles shows golden-yellow, glossy, thick liquid swirling around pale yellow noodles and green scallions.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon holds golden-brown broth, showing slight residue and a smooth, glossy surface.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly glossy surface with visible fibrous details.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is a thick, seared slice with pinkish-white meat, dark crust, and visible black pepper specks.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft texture and visible fibrous strands, curled into a gentle arc.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: round, pale white with pink swirl, slightly textured surface, small dark specks, irregular edge.
